writing.overall_comment: A strong, well-structured product-manager definition with clear routing triggers, explicit constraints, and a solid output contract, marred only slightly by mild verbosity.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description names concrete triggers (requirements analysis, feature breakdown, user stories, scope planning) and the domain clearly, so a main agent can route confidently.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, core principles, best practices, and an explicit output contract with deliverable shapes make the agent's behavior and outputs fully specified.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: Explicit 'must not' rules (no architecture/tech decisions, no committing scope/timelines) plus clear hand-back conditions give strong guardrails.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Well-organized and scannable, but some overlap between the role description, core principles, and best practices adds minor redundancy to the token budget.
